<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. The spectrum will show signals for carbon types; methyl carbons appear in the upfield region (~10‑30 ppm). By counting these signals (and considering symmetry), I can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
